mods.name: Faded Java Loader Bridge
mods.description: FJL bridge for enabled-mod Java plugin selection, restart checks, multiplayer plugin matching, and the shared FadedStack scheduler and command bus.

mods.name: Common Sense Reborn (Test)
mods.description: CSR Test 2.1.1: B42.22 compatibility with B42.21.0 support retained. Climbing, tutorial menus, FullHD, authoritative rope towing and all three optional Java plugins updated. Nearby requires FJL0.6.5 on42.22. Test only; never enable with Main.

mods.name: GroundWorks
mods.description: Standalone excavation and construction with vanilla tools. Dig outdoors or beneath existing houses; preview and frame preset trenches, moats and basements. Materials and time scale with the footprint. Intact framing prevents collapse. Generate deeper floors and walls, backfill, build routes and integrate optional equipment. All gameplay works through Lua alone. Optional FJL 0.3.4+ companion for PZ 42.20.4 adds local cutaways and retains the nearby surface while underground. No ZombieBuddy or PeekAView dependency. Toggle enhanced visibility in Sandbox Options. Foreground structures, lighting and extreme depth can still affect visibility. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20. After an FJL co-op restart, GroundWorks stays in the active mod list.

mods.name: Faded's ClearView UI
mods.description: Preserve vanilla timed-action constructor parameters and multiplayer inventory transaction timing.

mods.name: Deadflow
mods.description: Population authority for new Deadflow worlds on 42.20.4, 42.21 and Windows 42.22, with PZ Optimized 0.4.0 support. Older saved zombie snapshot formats are not migrated. Requires FJL 0.6.5+.

mods.name: CSR Clearview GPS
mods.description: Version 1.3.0. Standalone B42.20 Clearview GPS. Find a rare GPS tablet to open the gunmetal tablet window, plot a purple road route, autodrive, and follow live on network.fadedmods.com/map. Server-authoritative route cache in MP.

mods.name: Tactical Operations Center
mods.description: Tactical Operations Center 1.1.19: background admin data refreshes only on admin session joins/leaves; removes repeating claim-mirror retries and disables unused mirrors under CSR authority. Manual tools remain available. Companion 1.1.7 accepts Project Zomboid 42.21.0 and 42.20 and calls the optional spatial provider only when that mod is installed; Lua spatial calls stay available when it is absent. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Character Creator
mods.description: 2.7.1 hotfix: stops the applyCSRSkills nil-call error that dedicated servers logged every movement tick for playable characters, so their carry, run and sprint perks apply again. Includes all 2.7.0 Bre and Dante Willow content. Renderer plugin 1.0.2 is unchanged.

mods.name: Faded's Error Detected
mods.description: Build 42.20 and 42.21 diagnostics with ring-safe error capture, evidence-only attribution, a searchable ClearView-styled report interface, scalable detective alerts, persistent visibility controls, and installer update visibility. Its optional passive FJL performance profiler 1.0.3 remains server-only and accepts 42.21.0 and 42.20.2 through 42.20.4. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: BuckShot Roulette
mods.description: 1.0.1 raises the game version cap to 42.21.99. Server-authoritative Buckshot Roulette for one survivor against the Dealer or two nearby survivors. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Chocobo Go
mods.description: Chocobo companions, passenger riding, Gysahl farming, breeding, color-matched 3D feathers and fitted travel gear for Project Zomboid 42.20.4. Version 0.1.2. Full features require Faded's Java Loader 0.3.4 and FadedJavaLoaderBridge. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: MP ChronoController
mods.description: 2.2.0 adds per-player naps while group sleep acceleration and server time control stay in place. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: SentryNet
mods.description: SentryNet 0.1.0-alpha.4: correct B42 vehicle-part iteration and load/teleport guards for bounded storage auditing.

mods.name: KnoxNet OS
mods.description: Build 42.20 networked computer OS with a borderless desktop, managed app windows, secure terminal sessions, multi-floor storage logistics, server-authoritative CCTV and alarms, optional What A World weather reports, renewable-power and WEX telemetry, printing, banking, medical records, and survivor services. Version 0.9.3 binds the hottieZ browser to KnoxNetOS.Util so sendServer is no longer nil.

mods.name: Faded Trade Network
mods.description: Server-authoritative economy, multi-shop commerce, property ownership and leasing, Faction IDs and treasury finance, wealth rankings, and KnoxNet cash integration for Build 42.20 stable. Requires Common Sense Reborn or Common Sense Reborn (Test). Copyright (c) 2026 Faded / Faded Trade Network. All rights reserved; no reupload, redistribution, modpack bundling, forks, or modified releases without written permission.

mods.name: Buildcraft Reborn
mods.description: Build 42.21 three-window Craft / Build / Projects workspace with fast virtual catalogs, full-width project dock, native basements, reconstruction, manufacturing, planning, sewing, home zones, CSR-safe repair ownership, automatic roofing and garage doors, Architect blueprint planning with structure templates, build drafts, door salvage and repair, bank vaults, and an admin world editor. No dependencies.

mods.name: Faded Origins - Occupations & Traits
mods.description: 1.0.6 raises the game version cap to 42.21.99. Server-authoritative Resolve occupations and traits. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Faded Depths [WIP]
mods.description: WIP Java-first underground expansion for Build 42.20.4 / 42.21.0: town sewers, caverns, restored utilities, finite mining, air quality and a custom ClearViewUI-style survey. Server-authoritative SAFE_INSTANCE placement. Requires Faded Java Loader Bridge. Mods= only; never add FadedDepths to Map=. All three donor mods contribute. Isolated existing-save, restart and native geometry/room replay checks pass. Human SP streaming and two-client gameplay remain pending.

mods.name: Vehicles by Faded
mods.description: Vehicles by Faded 1.0.4: headlights shine forward from the lamp glass. Per-vehicle shader zone masks and lights; hoods and trunks open upward, doors swing on a vertical hinge; dark window glass; freezer syncs only on change.

mods.name: Echoes of Humanity
mods.description: The Harvest Sisters return every in-game and real-world October 31 with melee-only hunts, distinct powers, up to ten loyal raised followers, Whimsy Weapons integration and original English/Brazilian Portuguese female voices. Expands native households, practical work orders, colony facilities/research, survival guidance and requested companion driving. Requires FJL 0.5.0+. Adds optional Last Reins of Knox riding and carriage cooperation, more rural road travel, native NPC motor-car physics, seated survivor animations, and recruited companion passengers. Project Zomboid 42.21.

mods.name: The Young Died Too
mods.description: 1.1.2 recovers child-zombie corpse appearance after delayed multiplayer item replication, preserving a visible fallback until composite visuals are ready. Youth zombies, rare crawlers, and population-neutral conversions on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Faded's The Hive
mods.description: 2.3.2: Living Ladder stays on automatically. Fixes source-floor recruitment and unposed save/snapshot ownership, checks real save-floor support, and verifies damaged tower/ramp refill. Preserves combat-safe release.

mods.name: Water Expanded
mods.description: The comprehensive Build 42 water, plumbing, irrigation and fuel-network overhaul. One server-authoritative WEX graph connects pumps, valves, meters, seep channels, building-wide liquid plumbing, storage, fixtures, gas stations and generators without a bridge hub. Includes calibrated rain collectors, liquid-effect details, mains reconnection, physical petrol routing, portable pumping, quick view, public physical-container API, optional Faded Java Loader acceleration and KnoxNet OS bridge. Adds 800 L and 250 L stone cisterns, batched replication and indexed building matching. Optional Hybrid 1.0.2 retains the complete Lua fallback. Supports Build 42.21.0 and 42.20.

mods.name: Solar Never Faded
mods.description: Unified Build 42 power and resilience suite with Classic and Horizon hardware, Sentinel perimeter security, detailed 3D assets, pooled storage, EV charging, water, lighting, three-panel command UI, CSR integration, and KnoxNetOS Schema 2 API.

mods.name: Temp Control
mods.description: Server-authoritative HVAC and central heating: thermostat-controlled AC units plus industrial, home and compact boilers, with CSR/ClearView-styled controls. 1.1.1 makes the daily schedule switch only at its on/off times, so manual toggles and timers are no longer overridden.

mods.name: Faded Skies
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 helicopter flight, utility, and combat systems. Includes the FS UH-1B Iroquois utility helicopter and FS AH-64A attack helicopter. Designed for single-player, hosted multiplayer, and dedicated servers with server-authoritative weapons and noise.

mods.name: RVsReborn
mods.description: A cohesive Build 42.20 RV and Faded Locomotion interior system. Version 0.2.12 keeps multiplayer enter/exit authority with server-owned anchors and updates the optional native teleport bridge 1.0.1 for Project Zomboid 42.21.0 and 42.20.2 through 42.20.4, including the current position and online-id method shapes, while retaining a standalone Lua fallback. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Faded Locomotion
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42 rail system with multiple trains, detachable rolling stock, bidirectional routes, multiplayer track authority, claims integration, and RV-compatible passenger cars. Version 1.0.0 repairs consist rendering, coupler spacing, turn alignment, carrier scale, force-position synchronization, and first-notch braking, with an optional Faded Java Loader carrier-pinning bridge and a complete pure-Lua fallback.

mods.name: On The Move
mods.description: Qualify bicycle wheel model-part references to the existing Base models for B42.21 held rendering.

mods.name: Project Faded Car
mods.description: Integrated 3D car battery chargers, precise FJL placement and connected cable rendering, plus server-validated battery bench slots.

mods.name: Modern EVs
mods.description: Modern EVs 1.0.9: damage shells use the vanilla Veh_Damage textures again so the paint atlas is not sampled through the damage unwrap. The charge stand-in transmits only when its level changes. Engine, battery, muffler, and reservoir are topped up once when a car is first created, and can take damage after that. Generated white wheel discs stay hidden.

mods.name: Faded Vehicles Reborn
mods.description: Build 42.20 MP-centric vehicle lifecycle mod with server-authoritative replacement tickets, B42 timed-action complete hooks, safe spawn scans, admin controls, and CSR compatibility.

mods.name: CAT Construction
mods.description: Sixteen CAT-themed Build 42.20.4 construction vehicles with articulated equipment, working lights, vehicle mechanics, cargo handling, tree and stump clearing, and optional GroundWorks integration. Version 0.3.0 adds earth scooping, direct truck transfers, corpse collection, interchangeable crane tools, house demolition, visible tipper loads and dumpster fill.

mods.name: Military Vehicles Reborn
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 military vehicle pack by Faded. 21 vehicles and paint variants: Humvees, Abrams, Bradley, MRAP, cargo trucks, M109A3 artillery, M270 MLRS and M142 HIMARS. Version 2.1.1 finishes tan M1A2 and HIMARS paint, detail and shading, and increases both MRAP variants by 8%. Rigged guns and access parts, military dashboards, and server-controlled ordnance.

mods.name: Faded's Ride or Rot
mods.description: Preserve the B42.21 mechanics action constructor parameter names and order.

mods.name: Faded's Advanced Medical
mods.description: FAM 2.3.0 for Build 42.20.2+: timestamped medication coverage, compression and immobilization care, wound visuals, expanded arm prosthetics, and a polished three-sided triage workspace with reduced background work.

mods.name: Faded Farming & Fishing Reborn
mods.description: Preserve B42.21 grab-item and inventory-transfer constructor parameters while retaining cart restrictions.

mods.name: Just2Faded
mods.description: Standalone cultivation, processing and laboratory expansion. Grow tents, hydroponics, powered drying, named blends, reusable smoking pieces, vacuum storage, and integrated 3D laboratory assets.

mods.name: Parent's Journal
mods.description: A keepsake from home. Every survivor starts with Dad's Journal or Mom's Journal. Use it once to answer a few questions about your parent and receive bonus skill experience and personality traits based on your choices. The journal is consumed after you submit your answers.

mods.name: Salvaged Fuel Recovery Station
mods.description: Commission a fixed industrial generator and nearby tanks or barrels to manufacture and store gasoline or propane. Gasoline requires a hose and compatible container to recover; propane requires an empty propane tank.

mods.name: My Only Friend
mods.description: My Only Friend 3.0.0 development overhaul for PZ 42.21.0. Owned FJL companion control and animation graph, repaired breed motion, persistent dismiss/recall, genetics and aging, private veterinary care, original supplies and craftable homes/flap doors, visible pet gear and mass-limited cargo. CSR/ClearView-styled controls and pet preview. Requires FJL 0.6.3 on server and clients. Live graphical and two-client acceptance remain pending.

mods.name: Never Survive Alone
mods.description: 0.7.1-alpha fixes poster-wall opening checks for the 42.21 door/window API. Server-validated, explicit-opt-in adult intimacy, player scenes, Echoes NPC partner shared rest, wardrobe, Lifestyle and CSR Survivor Bond integrations remain available.

mods.name: Never Forget: Athena
mods.description: A small, respectful tribute to Athena. Admin-spawned, placeable, and made to hold a few warm moments of remembrance.

mods.name: Faded's Hunters Calling
mods.description: Qualify local static and world model references so they resolve in B42.21; align the displayed version.

mods.name: The Price We Pay
mods.description: Build 42.20 server-authoritative SP/MP arrest, restraint, escort, and prisoner transport mod.

mods.name: Skill Book Expansion
mods.description: Adds the missing Build 42.20.2 skill books and book sets for Axe, Long Blunt, Short Blunt, Short Blade, Spear, Nimble, Sprinting, Sneaking, Lightfooted, Fitness, and Strength.

mods.name: Faded's Lifestyle: Hobbies (All-in-One B42.20)
mods.description: Preserve all original crafting return values and qualify the custom chainsaw held model.

mods.name: Faded Legendary Kit
mods.description: Preserve every original crafting return value while retaining legendary crafting effects.

mods.name: Authentic Z
mods.description: SAFE TO ADD MID GAME

mods.name: Faded's Armor Pack
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 tactical armor collection with native night vision support, zombie outfits, and sandbox-controlled loot rarity.

mods.name: Faded Arsenal: Dead County Munitions
mods.description: Preserve all original inventory, magazine and visual wrapper returns; enable the KS7 standard 12-gauge suppressor; remove invisible stock fits on 15 weapons with baked stocks.

mods.name: Spongie's Open Jackets
mods.description: Alternate wearable styles for vanilla clothing, updated for Build 42.20.2.

mods.name: Spongie's Clothing [B42 Port]
mods.description: Build 42.20 compatibility port of Spongie's Clothing (21.42.20.5). Fixes body-location hide-model overrides without Java reflection (no getDeclaredField crash on 42.20.2). Original mod by Spongie; port prepared by Faded with permission/request from the original developer. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Faded's Feastcraft
mods.description: Native kitchen recipes, portion-aware cooking, distinct placeable food models, refreshed blue three-window UI and bounded multiplayer work.

mods.name: Faded Field Operations
mods.description: Preserve all original crafting return values while retaining quest activity tracking.

mods.name: Proximity Auto-Read
mods.description: Choose focused literature types or read every nearby unread knowledge item. Separates knowledge magazines from leisure magazines and uses Build 42.20 native read state and timed actions.

mods.name: It's A Trap!
mods.description: Build 42.21 cook-off ammo hotfix: tag checks use ItemTag objects instead of strings, so the hot-ammo server tick no longer throws on pots or other items in ovens, BBQs, fireplaces and campfires.

mods.name: The Path Less Traveled
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 native Skills-tab progression from level 10 to 15 with ClearView-style mastery cells and server-authoritative permanent category buffs.

mods.name: Faded Beds Have Blankets
mods.description: 1.2.7 reserves a distinct heated-blanket tile-definition number for compatibility with Water Expanded. Removable blankets, fifty heated quilt sets, larger pillows, bed warmth, and restful covered-bed sleep for Build 42.21. Existing sprite and item names are preserved.

mods.name: What A World
mods.description: 1.4.7 fixes black or invisible models caused by unsafe native model-uniform caching. Aliased alpha and ambient setters and external engine writes now reach stock shader uploads. Optional native plugin 1.3.4. Movement gear sounds, climate, weather stations, integrated world systems and consent-based performance advice remain available.

mods.name: The Walking Dead: Back to Atlanta
mods.description: Atlanta world/content with all 102 Walking Zomboid cells relocated beyond existing maps, 24 forest connector cells, eleven road links, generated M-map visuals, repaired biome/loot metadata and 19 selectable locations. Existing optional compatibility preserved.

mods.name: The Walking Dead: Back to Atlanta UI
mods.description: Complete location selection and responsive spawn-menu layout, with existing optional local comic visuals, CSR Utility HUD docking and ClearView ownership preserved.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus
mods.description: Federated Access & Data Exchange for Dedicated Servers. Version 0.4.11 keeps the periwinkle held-globe title screen and loads the Java bridge on PZ 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Survivor Pulse
mods.description: Private-by-default offline survivor dashboard for health, wounds, protection, body temperature, moodles, skills, equipment, loadout, encumbrance, nutrition extensions, and manifest-listed Faded mods. Version 1.1.2-nexus.3 skips Java-null ModInfo getters so missing catalog matches no longer spam getName errors. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Nutrition Matrix
mods.description: Offline nutrition matrix for F.A.D.E.D Nexus Survivor Pulse. Tracks calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, weight direction, and strength-training nutrition state without connecting or broadcasting.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // World Atlas
mods.description: Private-by-default offline second-screen world atlas with exploration fog, notes, custom-map baking, and vanilla-respecting multiplayer peer markers. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: PZ Optimized
mods.description: Performance assistance for Build 42.21 and 42.22 with exact-build performance payloads, stable GPU uploads, texture recycling and live status. Unreviewed builds disable optimizations and clean unchanged owned stale files during normal plugin startup. Includes persistent safe removal. Requires Faded Java Loader 0.6.5+.
